text:
alexa (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock MVP cuts today. Customers expect a launch window but infra warns of scope creep. who's available?

morgan (Eng Lead): here. timeline looks tight. two big risky pieces: private on-prem installer and canary A/B rollout automation. both need infra + storage work.

sam (Design): from UX POV we can ship console basics, but advanced rollout UI will be a poor experience if rushed. recommend placeholder flows.

alexa (PM): my proposal: move on-prem installer to v1, ship Dedicated as "beta" (API + reserved capacity) for key customers, delay A/B rollout automation to v1. keep hosted API, streaming, model catalog, and basic console metrics in MVP.

raj (CTO): agree with moves. on-prem is a big integration and compliance lift. cut it to v1. but we need a hard list of launch criteria to avoid scope creep.

morgan (Eng Lead): technical callouts: caching + kv consistency needs testing — can we accept SLIGHTLY higher cold-token latency for MVP? that saves 2 weeks.

alexa (PM): yes, accept cold-token latency tradeoff, must meet steady-state latency SLOs though.

tess (CS): customer voice — two potential customers asked specifically for dedicated capacity SLA and dev-friendly onboarding. they can accept "beta" wording if we give clear limits and manual provisioning.

sam (Design): for onboarding, we can do a templated quickstart (docs + sample repo) instead of full wizard. much faster.

morgan (Eng Lead): removed features list (suggested cuts):
```
- on-prem installer (move to v1)
- full A/B rollout automation (v1)
- advanced quantization recommendation UI (v1)
- long-tail telemetry retention >90 days (deferred)
```

alexa (PM): MVP must have clear launch criteria. Draft: 
```
- Hosted API endpoints (gen/chat/embeds) functional
- Model catalog with at least 2 verified models
- Streaming responses + function call support
- Basic Console: per-route latency + cost, token billing view
- Dedicated: API + reserved capacity provisioning (beta; manual setup ok)
- Auth, billing, basic audit logs
- E2E smoke tests + perf test under 50th/95th SLOs
```

raj (CTO): add 'fallback policy' requirement — must gracefully fall back to a cheaper model variant if capacity constrained. critical for reliability.

alexa (PM): good call. adding fallback policy. anyone object to moving those deferred items to v1?

morgan (Eng Lead): no objection. we can hit date if infra focuses on runtime, batching, and fallback. need two extra engineers for 3 weeks to stabilize caching.

alexa (PM): can we do a small timeline reset: push GA by 2 weeks to accommodate the stabilization work OR keep date if we cut more? preference for 2-week slip to avoid quality risk. thumbs? :+1: for slip, :-1: to keep date.

morgan (Eng Lead): :+1: for 2-week slip.

sam (Design): :+1: quality > rushing.

tess (CS): mixed — sales pressure, but we can negotiate for pilot customers. :+1: if we give clear pilot SLAs.

raj (CTO): :+1: take 2 weeks. avoids tech debt.

alexa (PM): consensus: shift GA +2 weeks, lock cuts listed. action items:
- alexa: update roadmap & announce cuts to stakeholders (today)
- morgan: scope infra hires / reallocate two engs for caching (by EOD)
- sam: prepare quickstart template + placeholder UI copy (48h)
- tess: notify pilot customers and draft beta terms (48h)
- raj: review fallback policy design (72h)

ci-bot: note — automated deploy windows unaffected. tagging thread for release notes.

alexa (PM): thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap PR and send a short summary to sales/legal. we'll reconvene Friday for final roll call.

morgan (Eng Lead): sounds good.

sam (Design): thanks.

tess (CS): on it.

raj (CTO): thanks all.
